basic-cards.name: Basic Cards
basic-cards.description: Show full-width information cards and two-column summary cards for verified findings, explanations, resources, trends, and status.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.description: View zones, traffic, DNS, Workers, and Pages, and let the Agent safely manage common operations.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: View profile, contribution calendar, and repository cards, and manage issues and pull requests.

notion.name: Notion
notion.description: Find and read authorized Notion pages and data sources, then create pages or append content with confirmation.

server-status.name: Server Management
server-status.description: Show server or NAS status and inspect Docker containers in the Agent's selected environment.

telegram-groups.name: Telegram Groups
telegram-groups.description: Read group messages, choose a group, reply, and vote; manage messages and members with confirmation.

twitter.name: X / Twitter
twitter.description: Read public posts, threads, profiles, timelines, and trends; use X API tokens for search and account actions.

v2ex.name: V2EX
v2ex.description: Browse trending and recent topics without signing in. Add a personal access token to read nodes, topics, and notifications, and to post or manage your topics.
